artifacts.content:
# Impact Assessment: Volunteer Connect

## Legend
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Source 1 | PRD: `L0-requirements-prd-composer`|
| Status (*Draft / In-Review / Approved*) | Draft |
| Approved by (Human Name) | *Human Name* |
| Date of Approval | *Date* |
| Human Approval Comments | *Comments* |

> KB: kb-L1-architecture-principles (Confluence page_id 524091393) — mode: KB-authority mode (no parent enterprise)

## Executive Summary & Overview
Volunteer Connect is a standalone greenfield app matching volunteers to community events.

No parent enterprise: catalog and CMDB are both empty, so all three components are new. Four KB-mandatory platform services are surfaced as external dependencies. Volunteer DB stores contact PII without a stated encryption constraint, flagged as a KB guardrail gap.
- **Overall impact level:** Low — all components new and isolated; no existing system touched
- **Existing systems:** 0 impacted, 0 explicitly excluded by architecture decision; duplicate-build risk: not assessable — no parent enterprise
- **External dependencies:** 4 total, 4 newly surfaced by this assessment
- **Flags:** No parent enterprise: service_catalog and cmdb_export both empty — KB-authority mode; KB guardrail gap: Volunteer DB stores PII but PRD states no encryption-at-rest constraint; Dependency cycle event-api <-> volunteer-web-app; build order not stated in PRD

## Non-Functional & Regulatory Impact
No existing SLAs affected. PII (FR-003) triggers KB encryption-at-rest and retention principles not stated in PRD.

## Existing-System Impact
**Capability check (service catalog, service grain):** No parent enterprise — service_catalog is empty; no closest service exists to compare.

**Technical impact check (CMDB, configuration-item grain):**

No parent enterprise — cmdb_export is empty; no CI rows. Stated finding, not omission.

## Components Identified
| Requirement | Component (new/existing) | Blast Radius | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Volunteer Web App (new) | Low | New isolated UI. |
| FR-002 | Event API (new) | Low | New service; no consumers yet. |
| FR-003 | Volunteer DB (new) | Medium | Holds PII; breach impact despite isolation. |

## Data Model & Schema Impact
New entities: Volunteer, Event, Registration (all new).

## Integration Landscape & External Dependencies
- **Upstream (KB-mandated platform):** Identity Provider — KB-mandatory infrastructure absent from PRD.
- **Upstream (KB-mandated platform):** API Gateway — KB-mandatory infrastructure absent from PRD.
- **Upstream (KB-mandated platform):** Observability Stack — KB-mandatory infrastructure absent from PRD.
- **Upstream (KB-mandated platform):** Secrets Manager — KB-mandatory infrastructure absent from PRD.

## Assumptions & Out of Scope
No integrations with external charities in scope.
